# StorePulse

StorePulse is a web application for comparing an app's rating and review count across local Apple App Store and Google Play storefronts.

## How it works

1. Search for an app by name.
2. Select the matching App Store or Google Play listing.
3. StorePulse retrieves the current rating and review-count data for more than 70 country storefronts.

## Data notes

- Ratings and review counts are retrieved from public storefront data at request time.
- A dash (`—`) means the selected storefront did not return rating data for that app.
- StorePulse does not publish editorial rankings or modify source storefront data.
